findings: Persisted DarwinState fields visible in the public type are activeVersions, per-agent active A/B tests, lastKnownGood, consecutiveFailures, experimentCounts, lifetime mergeInvocations, evolutionEnabled, and evolutionConfigOverrides. No alpha-wealth, e-value wealth, familywise-spend, proposal-risk, or cumulative sequential-error field is present in that state interface.

CLI-persisted advanced evolution overrides are limited to GEPA/merge/Pareto/coverage/reflection/demo/selection/feedback/merge-count/test-duration plus requireConfidence and confidenceMethod. There is no CLI flag or persisted override for a lifetime/cross-candidate error budget.

enabled-state.ts atomically persists those named overrides; confidence settings are merged into the nested per-agent SafetyThresholds. It does not maintain a spend/wealth value across completed A/B tests.

evolve.ts persists per-agent configuration and can force a new A/B test, while loop.ts clears a completed A/B test and later can generate another challenger. The same per-test safety configuration is reused; no completed-test spend is debited from a run-wide ledger in the inspected path.

metrics/sink.ts explicitly emits facts rather than aggregates and delegates counters/histograms to consumers. Its event model records run/rollback/A-B start/completion/timeout/skip events but supplies no controller-side risk-accounting state.
A direct repository code search for alphaWealth returned no indexed match, consistent with the explicit-file inspection but not independently conclusive.
